description: Publishes a new static site or version. New: every file, or a template. Update: site and base_revision with every file, or patch: true with changed files and deleted paths. Resize photos to the size shown (~2000 px), WebP/JPEG 80%.

idempotency_key.description: New sites: a random UUID; a retry with the same files replays the result

preview.description: true: save a private preview, not live

template.description: Template, e.g. "brasa" (files sent replace its paths)

workspace.description: New sites: workspace id or name, or "private" (omitted with several, the reply asks)

name: deploy
title: Publish site
